scope: World-owned natural boulders, native detailed/distant fracture tiers, shared surface requests, active-camera selection and local interaction. Not universal seamless rendering or the full overhaul.
implementation: Original 0BSD code and tests using existing project geometry, materials and native dependencies. No imported implementation or new external dependency. CPU native tier selection and GPU shader blending/animation; no new compute shader.

fixture.persistence_policy: Writable compound-save checks use unique owned clones; forest and driving checks use the original read-only fixture. No player save was overwritten.

budgets.scope: Far geometry has no object-distance retirement; frustum, terrain occlusion, camera clipping and fog still apply. Physics remains player-local.

native_checks.scope: Legacy candidate/pose parity, 2048-root pressure beyond the old 512 cap, 100000-m far membership, projection overlap, damage/expiry in both tiers, invalid-publication atomicity, reset and sparse picking.

installed_boulder_lifecycle.scope: Production contact calls, binary roundtrip and compound save/new world instance. Not attack-input animation, cross-process reopen or user visual acceptance. Clone loading is not directly comparable with read-only forest timings.

installed_forest_regression.scope: Shared requests avoid duplicate forest/boulder sampling. This is not a loading speedup over the older local-only boulder baseline.

installed_road_camera_sweep.scope: Controlled road-camera sweep, not physical vehicle endurance. Scoped boulder coordinator improvement, not whole-frame improvement. Grass owner-residency deficits are not measured pixel gaps. Process-specific resource counters are sampled, not allocator caps or physical 4-GiB hardware qualification.

retained_failures_and_limits: reports/checks/20261030T104917229986Z: rendered fracture fixture mistakenly invoked headless; frame-post-draw wait timed out. Rendered regression passes.

reports/checks/20261030T105226939705Z: expiry fixture SceneTree timer included preceding long frame; replaced with actual elapsed ticks matching the native clock. Subsequent debug/release checks pass.

reports/runtime_views/20261030T112105341136Z: overstrict coverage.ready assertion failed during queued exclusion reconciliation while all 368 roots remained rendered. Regression now checks actual identities, poses and render count.

Earlier high-view fixture moved the first-person camera instead of using production overview. It could not detect the wrong boulder camera binding. Binding and fixture are corrected; final evidence uses the actual overview camera.
Initial duplicate surface requests increased cold loading; final implementation shares bounded forest requests with independent fallback only for missed/resampled pages.
Export retains pre-existing nested ZombieLab and old rejected-ramp snapshot UID warnings; final startup and installed tests pass without runtime diagnostics.

temporary_world_cleanup.scope: Deletion command was rejected before execution; no bypass attempted. Existing runner already removed its successful derived caches. Worlds and failed-test evidence are not disposable caches.

remaining: Continuous pixel-level LOD transition review and user visual acceptance.
